description: Source code for a Linux kernel GPIO Button Hotplug driver, managing GPIO-based button events, including handling interrupts, polling, and event broadcasting.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a formatted variable string to a uevent skb buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event with standard environment variables for button hotplug event.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button hotplug event.

methods.name: gpio_keys_button_probe
methods.description: Probes and initializes GPIO buttons, requesting GPIOs and setting up data structures.

methods.name: gpio_keys_probe
methods.description: Main probe function for gpio-keys driver, sets up IRQs and polling.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_probe
methods.description: Probe function for polled GPIO keys driver.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_close
methods.description: Disables IRQs and cancels work for GPIO keys.

methods.name: gpio_keys_remove
methods.description: Removes driver, unregisters IRQs and polling.
